title: The Mummy
short: Five films including The Scorpion King
blurb: Three adventure films, a spin-off set five thousand years earlier, and a 2017 reboot with no connection to any of them.

m08.t: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor

note: The Scorpion King expands a character introduced in The Mummy Returns, so watching it first means meeting him without context. The 2017 film is a failed reboot and unconnected.
